Common Questions

Before You Reach Out

How do I book a stay?

Email us with your preferred dates and group size. We'll confirm availability, share details, and collect a deposit via Venmo to hold your dates.

Is the walkthrough always included?

Yes — either in-person with Jen when we're on-site, or via the 4-hour recorded video walkthrough with projector setup when we're traveling.

How many guests can you host?

Comfortably 2–4 guests. The property can accommodate up to 6 for group stays — reach out to discuss options.

Is it actually off-grid?

No — Sustainabox is grid-connected (water, septic, electric) but designed with resilience principles. Think of it as infrastructure-ready with self-sufficiency in mind.

Can I bring my own build plans to review?

Absolutely. Many guests come with specific questions about their own projects. Bring drawings, photos, or questions and we'll work through them together.

Do you offer consulting without a stay?

Yes. We offer remote design review, planning packages, and ongoing support — no travel required. See the Offerings page for details.
